name: application-ticket-tier-selector
title: Ticket Tier Selector
description: Ticket purchase tier list with a quantity stepper per tier and a footer showing the total ticket count and running price total.
useWhen: Building an event checkout flow where users select quantities across multiple ticket tiers (GA, VIP, etc.).
You want a live running total computed from independent per-tier quantities, not a single mutually-exclusive choice.
Distinct from Variant Selector, which picks one option among mutually exclusive choices (like a size or color) rather than independent per-tier quantities.
avoidWhen: Only one ticket type exists — a single quantity stepper next to a price is simpler than a tiered list.
The choice is mutually exclusive (pick exactly one tier) rather than additive — use Variant Selector or a radio group instead.
responsiveBehavior: Each tier row keeps its name/description and stepper on one line; the footer's ticket count and total price never wrap independently of each other.
accessibility: Each stepper's decrement and increment buttons carry an aria-label naming the specific tier ("Decrease VIP Balcony quantity"), since their visible content is just − and + glyphs.
The decrement button is a real disabled control at zero, not just visually muted, preventing quantity from going negative.
The footer total is always a live, literal sum of quantity × price per tier, computed the same way whether zero or many tiers are selected.

variants.title: Ticket Tier Selector
variants.description: Three tiers (General Admission at 2, VIP Balcony and Backstage Pass at 0) with per-tier steppers and a footer showing '2 tickets' and a $130.00 total.
accessibility: Decrement buttons at zero quantity are real disabled elements, removed from the tab order.

variants.title: Ticket Tier Selector (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-tier list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Stepper button contrast and disabled-state muting remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
